text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it's about time. Let's head back, 
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry! I'm coming right no—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...You've been like that all day today. 
Are you feeling alright?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, don't feel bad, it's nothing like 
that...! My joints are just creaking a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay? Maybe you should have 
a doctor take a look at it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you could talk to your Trainer about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, I'm working hard with a 
really positive mindset.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer and I were both confident, 
thinking we were going to run a great race 
at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen too..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't want to ruin the current 
mood.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'll let you know if it starts 
hurting really bad! But for now, I'm still 
okay!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... If it hurts, then just say 
"ouchie" and be done with it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, I can cast a spell on you if you 
want! One that'll make you feel way more 
energetic. Consider it a special treat!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sui-chan... Thank you very much♪

One day, while training in preparation for 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... I'll keep going!

However, even after that, Nishino Flower 
still seemed to have trouble moving her 
body naturally.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew... Great work today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... what about it?
choice_data_list: Is your body feeling off anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No. I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... it's just, my body feels a little 
bit tired...
choice_data_list:
Then why don't we call it a day after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I-I'm fine! I can still train!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it, I...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...I-I'm sorry! I'll go get changed...!"

...Something is off with Nishino Flower. 
Still, since she hasn't said anything, it 
wouldn't be right to press her on it right 
now.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. She is a girl who will grow so 
much bigger "from here on out."

...Perhaps this isn't a bad sign. Let's 
keep an even closer eye on the situation 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I... told a lie.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry, Trainer. But I'm really okay, 
so I didn't want you to worry...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...It's really gonna be okay, right? If 
it gets worse...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...If I lie, will my body get ruined too?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! No, I'm okay. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm okay...――

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

Even during the next training session, 
Nishino Flower still wore a gloomy 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I'm sorry...! Um, well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going for a run...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...! Ugh...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Something's definitely weird... My legs 
aren't moving the way I want them to...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(No, that can't be! It wouldn't just 
change so suddenly. It's not like 
everything suddenly went wrong...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm fine... I'll be fine...! As long as I 
stay mindful while running...—)

Nishino Flower seemed awkward right from 
the start. She gradually slowed down until 
she finally came to a complete stop...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I lied... I wasn't okay at all...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My legs, they just won't move right... I 
can tell that it's... different from 
before...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... It's totally ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so, sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I... I can't... run anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!

Nishino Flower was sobbing uncontrollably. 
Her anxiety-filled heart pierced straight 
through me. And yet...

Listening to her story, I was convinced. 
Right now, she stands... at a crossroads 
of change.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh, *hic*... *sniffle*, uuu...
choice_data_list: Let's go see the doctor together.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, your body must be going through a 
growth spurt.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My... body?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You skipped a grade to enter here. 
Even though you'd begun your growth 
period, your age—your body was still 
younger than the other girls'.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
But now, her physique is finally 
developing to match that of the other 
girls.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
About the same, huh... Then what about 
joint pain or anything like that...?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
It's likely just growing pains. I examined 
her, but there's nothing wrong with her 
body.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
It's proof that your body is changing in 
order to grow bigger.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...Am I... getting bigger...?"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Yes! Congratulations, Nishino Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... What a relieeeef...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I... I lied to you, Trainer, and I'm 
worried that it's only made me worse...
choice_data_list:
You didn't want to make anyone worry, 
right?

You didn't want to make anyone worry, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... even so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I won't ever let you go to waste.
Because I won't ever let you go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like you've really grown a lot 
over these past two years too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. You're a Trainer I'm truly proud of!

And so, Nishino Flower's "growth spurt" 
began!
